overall_explanation:
Scoped Source review supports all 16 arrows against Git object 3cf7dc4f72c2ae1e0ba4c47cceb08c98f4c70b7f. Paths below are relative to skills/ unless stated otherwise.
1. Pipeline→Nova: nova/core/test-gates/pipeline.ts:25–51 reads the selected declaration, including optional tests, fixtures, suites, coverage and concurrency limits.
2. Nova resolves/digests: nova/core/test-gates/resolver.ts:720–754 validates, resolves, hashes and freezes the plan.
3. Nova archives: nova/core/test-gates/source-snapshot.ts:31–59 resolves a commit/tree, archives committed bytes and signs their identity.
4. Nova→stores: nova/core/test-gates/remote-dispatch-store.ts:29–56 persists the job and archive; dispatch-operation.ts:23–27 awaits persistence before transport.
5. Nova→Buster: remote-dispatch.ts:138–158 submits POST; dispatch-operation.ts:37–54 first checks existing status and submits only after absence.
6–7. Buster validates/persists: buster/engine/test-gates/remote-plan-service.ts:94–165 checks signature, archive, plan/request identities, reserves result capacity and persists accepted status; :492–547 additionally checks registry, grants, service capacity and dependencies.
8. Buster→runner: remote-plan-service.ts:673–775 prepares/extracts source and passes the fixed plan, grants, limits and cancellation signal to TestPlanRunner; an injected executor is an explicit alternate implementation.
9. Runner→Worker: runner.ts:1520–1605 constructs the bounded attempt envelope and invokes Worker runtime/executor.
10. Worker→sandbox: runner.ts:1192–1229 loads/executes the provider inside its Worker operation callback; provider-loader.ts:52–79,137–169,417–423 verifies/copies the exact package and launches isolation. This is an architectural relationship, not a claim that Worker Core owns the provider loader.
11. Sandbox→runner: provider-loader.ts:271–303,359–362 returns provider results; runner.ts:1229–1238 validates facts, reports and evidence declarations.
12. Runner→service: remote-plan-service.ts:762–799 receives attempts, nodes and cleanup errors and binds the result receipt.
13. Storage: artifacts.ts:92–110 exclusively writes evidence and freezes digest references; remote-plan-service.ts:217–258 stores terminal result bytes and guards completion.
14. Nova fetches: remote-dispatch.ts:161–195 polls/fetches exact digest objects; remote-result-import.ts:213–245 bounds and verifies evidence. Buster HTTP authorization precedes these routes (remote-plan-http.ts:122–158).
15. Nova verifies/judges: remote-result-authority.ts:35–115,117–190 validates identities/receipts and applies report-count, coverage and gate policy.
16. Nova→stores: remote-result-import.ts:154–196 writes pending intent, checks conflicts, stores blobs and guards completion.
Failure/cancellation can stop this path; skipped nodes need no attempt, reports/evidence are conditional, and failed/cancelled statuses have no completed result. Receipts are deterministic hash bindings (contracts/pipeline-test-gate/v1/src/…
